Emma — thanks for the quick info and the attachments, got them. Sorry you're hitting that error; we'll sort it. I added Laura (Vendor Ops) and Marcus (Procurement Integrations) to help with portal provisioning and to check whether an existing placeholder record is blocking your signup.

Short checklist so we can move fast:
- Confirm legal name + EIN (received)
- W-9 (received)
- Bank details for ACH (we can collect after initial record creation)
- Billing contact and remit email (please confirm if Carlos is primary)
- Any special payment terms (Net30, Net45 etc.)

Portal note: Redwood uses Coupa for most SaaS vendor POs; occasional customers use Ivalua/Ariba. If Coupa reports an "existing account" error it usually means a prior invitation was started with a different email or an SSO affiliation. Marcus — can you check Coupa for any existing Luminar entries and open a vendor provisioning ticket if needed?

Emma — if you can share a screenshot of the signup error (or forward the support message), that helps. I'm available Thurs 2/12 at 2:00pm PST or Fri 2/13 at 11:00am PST for a 30-minute call. Which works best?

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks team — following up after checking Coupa. I found a stale placeholder entry that looks like it was created during an earlier outreach (different email). I opened a support case with Coupa and quoted the internal vendor id we found. Case: CR-7893 (Coupa support). They indicated the most likely path is to either merge the existing placeholder with the new record or have Coupa support reassign the email.

Temporary workaround while Coupa resolves the case:
- We can create a manual PO in our ERP against the placeholder vendor and route invoices to manual matching (short-term, works for one-off onboarding POs).
- Alternatively, we can wait for Coupa to complete the merge (~24-48 hours) and then proceed with normal PO issuance.

Next steps:
1) Tessa — confirm whether Luminar wants us to issue the first PO as a manual entry or to wait for network merge.
2) Laura — if we go manual, can you run the PO creation and include Luminar remit email as billing contact?
3) Emma/Carlos — confirm you will attend the 2/12 2:00pm PST call (I will join to verify the Coupa status).

I'll keep CR-7893 updated and share the Coupa response here.

Marcus Lin
Procurement Integrations Engineer
